reviews.review_msg: Lectures were not helpful, she just read off the slides and didn't actually teach or expand on any of the topics. However, I think this class is pretty self learn heavy. Exams were quite fair, relatively similar to the homework questions and practice problems given.

Great prof, but the course content was definitely tough and moved fast. The slides were helpful and assignment expectations were very clear. In-class examples went quickly, but she was really patient if you asked for help or emailed her. She was a fair grader and gave quick feedback.

Did not attend most lectures (hence gave 4/5) and still did great. Just practice her examples a lot and keep up with the lectures every week and you will be fine. She was quick to help as well but the couple times I did attend lecture she called on students.
Calls on students at random, sounds scared like she doesn't now what she's talking about, and gets angry when students don't participate.

I could say, Listen carefully for the lectures, then you would be fine for the exams.
